title: galium timeroyi subsp. fleurotii
intro: Galium timeroyi subsp. fleurotii, commonly known as Fleurot's bedstraw, is a subspecies of the Galium genus, a type of flowering plant. This plant is used for its medicinal properties and is believed to have various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Galium timeroyi subsp. fleurotii include its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce anxiety and stress, and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
